task: Fix /admin/medias multi-image upload; validate against Supabase bucket limit before upload; smooth UX

facts.rootCause: All files posted in ONE request to /api/medias; Vercel serverless body cap ~4.5MB → multi/large upload 413 → client if(response.ok) false → spinners hang.
facts.fix: Signed-URL direct-to-Supabase upload (bypasses body cap, honors 50MB bucket limit) + client validation.

stories.title: Shared media limits + client validation module
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/media-upload.ts (or validations/medias.ts) exports MAX_FILE_SIZE=52428800 and ALLOWED_MIME matching the products bucket
A validateImageFile(file) helper returns an error string for wrong mime or oversize, null when OK

stories.title: Signed-upload + confirm API routes (admin-gated)
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/medias/sign: admin check; body {files:[{name,type,size}]}; validates mime+size; returns [{name, path, token}] via createSignedUploadUrl on service-role client
POST /api/medias/confirm: admin check; body {items:[{key,alt}]}; inserts medias rows; returns [{id,key,alt}]
Non-admin → 403; invalid file → per-file error, not a whole-batch failure

stories.title: Client upload util (validate → sign → uploadToSignedUrl → confirm)
acceptanceCriteria: uploadImagesViaSignedUrl(files, {onFileStatus}) validates each file, requests signed URLs, uploads each directly to Supabase via browser client uploadToSignedUrl, confirms DB rows
Returns inserted media rows [{id,key,alt}] for the succeeded files

stories.title: Rewrite UploadMediaContainer with smooth multi-upload UX
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting/dropping multiple images uploads all (no aggregate body cap)
Per-file tile shows spinner while uploading and clears/refetches when done; errors toast per file
File input resets so the same files can be re-selected; oversize/wrong-type rejected with a message before upload

stories.title: MultiImageDialog upload uses the same signed-URL util
acceptanceCriteria: The 'Upload từ máy tính' button in MultiImageDialog uploads via the shared util (no single-request /api/medias POST)
Uploaded medias auto-selected and library refetched as before
